deliverables: fill-ring produce_and_wakeup on all three fill paths (prime, replenish, RX-frame return) — XDP_USE_NEED_WAKEUP sockets now wake the driver after fill starvation instead of sleeping forever
per-worker AF_XDP TCP session budget: node budget divided across queue reactors (floor 1); adding queues no longer multiplies the whole-node session quota

worker lease: proxy_workers_starting flag + per-reactor readiness channel; redirect opens only after every expected worker reports ready (10s timeout); startup failure/timeout disables redirect explicitly with a recorded fallback reason
proxy_bridge_should_continue accepts starting workers so the lease covers the startup window without opening redirect

generation-aware bridge supervisor: reload manager replacement respawns the bridge only after the new manager attaches and AF_XDP setup settles; stale-manager workers exit via generation check; same-generation bridge failure is not blindly respawned
explicit xskMode bind policy: auto (probe zero-copy then copy), copy, zero-copy (hard failure, no silent downgrade); landed mode recorded per queue in XdpQueueStatus.xsk_mode and detail
bind error messages carry the attempted mode (e.g. 'AF_XDP zero-copy bind failed: ...')
same-interface/same-RX-queue redirect and bounded QUIC DCID steering to the owning XSK (pre-existing, re-verified)
